mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 5.0% and remains elevated for three consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that depress corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 3-month moving averages signals robust consumer and housing demand, which accelerates economic growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a recessionary regime (defined by two consecutive quarterly declines in real GDP), a rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates the beginning of a supply-side recovery, which boosts corporate profits and generates positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when GDPC1 shows two consecutive quarterly declines and INDPRO rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPI exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5d returns are positive in > 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY change > 3.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts (HOUST) consistently signals improving residential construction activity and consumer confidence, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when HOUST rises, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls, or the interaction term in a regression has a negative coefficient with p>0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong consumer demand regime (RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars), a rising housing starts (HOUST) signals sustained economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are negative in > 60% of instances when RSAFS > 700,000 and HOUST rises (3-month growth > 0.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.
